verdict.rationale: Penpot's AI story is built entirely around its MCP server, which lets external AI agents read and interact with design data as structured code (penpot-docs-32, penpot-docs-31), enabling agents to potentially surface insights or suggestions — but this is a bring-your-own-agent integration layer, not a native in-product AI feature that surfaces insights/suggestions to users. Runtime probes confirm the MCP server truly works self-hosted (penpot-probe-rt-2), but no evidence shows Penpot itself generating analysis, recommendations, or suggestions from user data. Missing for 10: any native AI insights/suggestions UI or feature inside Penpot itself, first-party examples of AI-generated design suggestions, and independent evidence of this working in practice.
